t: r/questforglory on Reddit: Which is your favourite Quest for Glory game?
s: August 29, 2023 - Hero's Quest / QFG1 EGA was my first video game love, and 1 & 2 EGA will always be my favorites. WoW was a weaker experience and QFG4 was unplayable for years for those of us who bought it at release. I didn't play QFG1 vga until the 2000s, so it has no nostalgic value for me, though I enjoyed it.
